title: Whole-system coefficient square for the proper counit
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite extension E, n≥1, a normalized six-functor datum d, invertibility of the coefficient prime, and realized coefficient-system operations o,z. For proper f:X→Y and constructible integral K,L with uniform finite-reduction Tor amplitude for L, let c be the identity-open compactification. Then sourceMap(c,K,L) followed by the system compactificationProjection equals system reduction of properViaSupport(d,f,K,L) followed by targetMap(c,K,L), with the explicit coordinates of [def-sf-integral-projection-finite-evaluation-data] and [def-sf-integral-projection-coordinate-data]. This is a square of whole coefficient systems; it asserts no finite tensor or finite projection identity.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Form the actual inverse pullback reduction square and its adjunction mate direct. Use tensor-pullback reduction compatibility and the mate/counit identity in rightAdjointProjectionMap_mate to prove the direct-image projection square. Cancel the inverse pullback comparison on its target using inputReduction inverse. This argument is written completely in Lean.

Apply the one-input support/direct identity to K and to the tensor/pullback input. Tensor naturality gives the source comparison equation; naturality of openIdentity gives the target comparison equation. Apply system identity-open projection cancellation, paste the direct-image square, and cancel the target identity-open isomorphism. Expand properViaSupport and cancel properIdentity inverse against properIdentity.

lean.statement:
theorem integralProperProjectionSystemNormalization
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (d : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f.hom.left]
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
    (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left)
    (hL : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left L.obj) :
    FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.sourceMap
        D C E d.higher hl o z f (.ofIsProper f.hom.left) K L ≫
      compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons
        (.ofIsProper f.hom.left)
        ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
        ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) =
      (calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.map (properViaSupport d f K L).hom ≫
        FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.targetMap
          D C E d.higher hl o z f (.ofIsProper f.hom.left) K L
